sample.title: Parties
sample.body: This Agreement is made between {{org.legalName}} (the Company) and {{employee.fullName}}, holder of identity number {{employee.govId}}, residing at {{employee.address}} (the Employee).

sample.title: Code of Conduct
sample.body: The Employee shall comply with the Company policies, code of conduct and lawful instructions, and shall act with integrity and professionalism at all times.

sample.title: Working Hours
sample.body: Normal working hours are 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, in accordance with Indonesian manpower law and Company arrangements.

sample.title: Annual Leave
sample.body: The Employee is entitled to annual leave in accordance with prevailing law and Company policy.

sample.title: Social Security
sample.body: The Company shall enrol the Employee in {{ss.scheme}}, covering {{ss.programs}}, with contributions made in accordance with prevailing regulations.

sample.title: Confidentiality
sample.body: The Employee shall keep confidential all proprietary and non-public information of the Company, during and after employment, and shall not disclose it without authorisation.

sample.title: Intellectual Property
sample.body: All work product, inventions and materials created by the Employee in the course of employment are the exclusive property of the Company.

sample.title: Personal Data Protection
sample.body: The parties shall process personal data in accordance with UU No. 27/2022 on Personal Data Protection and the Company privacy policy.

sample.title: Governing Law & Dispute
sample.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Disputes shall be resolved amicably and, failing that, through the competent Industrial Relations Court.

sample.title: Confidentiality
sample.body: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed under this agreement and use it solely for the purpose of the engagement.

sample.title: Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
sample.body: This agreement is governed by the laws of {{country}}. Disputes shall be resolved amicably, failing which through the competent courts or agreed arbitration.

sample.title: Scope of Services
sample.body: The Provider shall deliver the services described in the proposal and any attached statement of work, in a professional and workmanlike manner.

sample.title: Deliverables & Acceptance
sample.body: Deliverables shall be submitted per the agreed schedule. The Client shall review and accept, or provide written comments, within the agreed acceptance period.

sample.title: Fees & Payment Terms
sample.body: Fees are as set out in the proposal quotation. Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date unless otherwise agreed. Applicable taxes are added.

sample.title: Term & Termination
sample.body: This agreement remains in force for the engagement term. Either party may terminate for material breach not remedied within 30 days of written notice.

sample.title: Intellectual Property
sample.body: Deliverables prepared for the Client become the Client’s property upon full payment. The Provider retains rights to its pre-existing methodologies and tools.

sample.title: Limitation of Liability
sample.body: Except for breach of confidentiality, each party’s aggregate liability is limited to the fees paid under this agreement. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss.

sample.title: Warranties & Service Levels
sample.body: The Provider warrants that services will conform to the agreed scope and applicable professional standards, and will re-perform non-conforming services at no additional cost.
